profile.headline: Software Engineer at L3Harris Technologies
profile.summary:
I’m a Design Engineer / Front-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience working at the intersection of software engineering, UI/UX, and human-computer interaction.
 
At L3Harris Technologies, I currently develop and maintain a metadata-driven React/Redux frontend for a customer-facing defense data-management platform, dynamically generating forms, validation, and migration workflows from backend-defined metadata. My previous work has included designing and developing interfaces for real-time embedded systems and contributing to next-generation GPS ground control software.
 
Outside of work, I created Maneuver, an open-source, offline-first scouting and strategy platform for FIRST Robotics Competition teams. Maneuver has reached 8,000+ users across 15 countries, with teams using it from their first structured scouting programs through the FIRST World Championship. I designed and built the product in React/TypeScript around a reusable, year-agnostic architecture and continue to iterate on it based on feedback from teams using it in real competition environments.
 
Building Maneuver has reinforced what I enjoy most: understanding complex workflows, designing an experience around the people using them, and then building the production implementation myself.
 
I earned my B.E. in Software Engineering from Stevens Institute of Technology and am currently pursuing an M.S. in Computer Science with a Human-Computer Interaction specialization at Georgia Tech.
 
I’m especially interested in Design Engineer, UX Engineer, and Design Technologist roles where engineering is closely integrated with product and design.

positions.description:

• Developed Java and Python software for the navigation component of the next-generation GPS ground control system, supporting accurate real-time position and velocity data for space vehicles.

positions.title: Associate, Software Engineer
positions.description:

● Designed and implemented user interfaces that preserved familiar operator interaction patterns while improving visual feedback and reducing distraction.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Utilize C++ on embedded real-time operating systems
• Work closely with cross-functional members to develop interfaces between hardware and software
• Participate in an agile development process with daily scrums and bi-weekly sprint planning meetings

positions.title: Application & Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented a full-stack internal bug bounty website, increasing security and streamlining the bug-reporting process by providing a centralized platform for reporting and tracking issues, using MongoDB, Express, React, and NodeJS
• Developed a front-end for an intern database, resulting in increased efficiency and ease of use for HR processes, using Angular/HTML/SCSS
• Integrated multiple Google Cloud Platform services (Cloud functions, Pub/Sub, Big Query, Data Studio) into a seamless data pipeline from a sensor board to a user-friendly data visualization dashboard, enabling real-time monitoring and analysis of key metrics
positions.insights: Skills: React · Angular · JavaScript · MongoDB · Express.js · Node.js · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

projects.title: Maneuver
projects.description:
Maneuver is an open-source, offline-first scouting and strategy suite for FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) teams that has reached more than 8,000 users since 2025.

It gives teams a single platform for match and pit scouting, data validation, interactive analytics, alliance selection, and match-strategy planning—all designed to remain useful in competition environments where internet connectivity is limited or unavailable.

I built Maneuver with React and TypeScript around a reusable, year-agnostic architecture, using IndexedDB for local-first persistence and resilient device-to-device data sharing through technologies including Luby Transform QR fountain codes and WebRTC.
